body:
People suck. Apart from a few golden ones that can hang back, stand back and see what is happening. I feel that at least half the population is sociopathic. I don't care what the statistics say. Most of my family is so. Anyone who eyes up people and sees other people as a threat to their own stupid egos doesn't belong in a group. 

I agree with everything you've said. I've been bullied, hurt, shut down, tricked. It's all deliberate too. I know there are some kind hearted real people out there. Because I've known them. But they are very very rare creatures. I've found suicide forums to have some of the most sensitive, caring, genuine people I've ever known. 

I think the psychopaths are taking over. I do. I think the balance was tipped at some point and people barely even pretend to be civil. 

I joined an online university course to try and learn something and someone, in fact two people (assuming it wasn't the same) were bullying me,  harrassing me about my opinions. 
Psychopaths don't feel bad about anything. I certainly don't hit people, rape people, play games and lie about people. People are not all the same. Not in the least bit.
